conditions.desktop: Bundled headed full Chromium, observed ~120 Hz
conditions.phone: Physical Pixel 7a Chrome, touch input, observed ~60 Hz

limits: Noclip is an explicit continuous streaming stress control, not ordinary collision or input behavior. Ordinary extended phone sprints stopped and are labelled.
Tracing and phase wrappers allocate and perturb scheduling; compare untraced results separately. Live-heap snapshots are not allocation attribution.
Slow intervals exceed 1.5 times observed median cadence, not a direct hardware presentation counter. Absolute over-25-ms counts are retained.
GPU-process elapsed/CPU work is not GPU hardware execution timing. Browser traces can contain work from other targets. Overlap alone is not proof of cause.
Phase timings are inclusive: submission, page copying and flushing overlap; do not add their totals.
First post-ready cold sample is not total navigation/startup time.
Tests cover GPU sprites. Mesh-heavy content and the separate Traffic lab cache-policy conflict need their own measurements.
Runtime engine remains at the recorded revision. Only benchmark controls/analysis changed; pre-existing documentation edits were left intact.
